Immigration Reform Bill discussion
in US Congress
*401. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
an Immigration Reform Bill is likely to be
discussed in the US Congress which may
raise the hope of an increase in employment
based immigration visas and temporary
skilled workers visas; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Competitive edge to post offices
*402. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the share of
post offices in collection, transmission and
delivery of mail, money transfer and various
financial services has declined over the
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken to provide competitive
edge to post offices in the country?
Promotion of sports and sportsmen
*403. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the special package and facilities
envisaged to promote and enhance the skills
of Indian Players and Sportsmen except
usual and conventional practices that are in
existence at present;
(b) the policy initiative to promote and
project Sports and Games in general and in
respect of few games and sports in particular
having good deal of prospects in India; and
(c) whether it is a fact that most of

126
outstanding players and sportsmen have
reached their zenith on account of their own
rather than the environment and the facilities
offered to them by Governmental agency?
Providing computers in village post
offices of Uttaranchal
*404. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to provide modern and effective computers
in all post offices located in the villages and
hilly areas of Uttaranchal;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Availability of telephone equipments
 *405. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL  APTE:
SHRI VINAY KATIYAR:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
estimate regarding requirement of telephone
equipments for providing landline and
mobile telephone connections in the urban
and rural areas of Chhattisgarh, Madhya
Pradesh, Maharashtra and U.P.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken to ensure availability
of telephone equipments to exhaust the
waiting list; and
(d) the time by when the connections
on demand are likely to be provided?
Quality of MTNL and BSNL mobile
services
†*406.  SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
in comparison to mobile services of other
private companies the mobile services of
MTNL and BSNL are lagging behind,
quality-wise;
(b) whether Government have given any
attention to this fact that the roaming
facility is available in the public cellular
service but due to lack of clarity in voice,
frequent interruption or disturbance in the
network, difficulty in making calls has
become a regular feature; and
(c) the measures contemplated by
Government for bringing improvement in
their mobile services in comparison to other
companies and by when these measures
will be implemented alongwith the details
thereof?
Installation of de-duping software
*407. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have directed telecom operators to install
de-duping software by August, 2006 to
uncover multiple connections;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action proposed to be taken
against operators who do not comply with
the instructions within the prescribed date?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Programmes on farmers on DD
*408. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROADCAST-
ING be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the programmes
concerning farmers on DD;
(b) Government's response of such
programmes;
(c) whether Government have evaluated
their reach and contents, etc. recently; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

Setting up of a Coal Videsh Ltd.
2879. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has decided
to move ahead with plan to allow Coal
India Ltd. to set up a new subsidiary
company Coal Videsh Ltd. for acquiring
coal blocks abroad;
(b) if so, whether Ministry of Finance
had objected to this proposal and
suggested that Coal India itself should do
the acquisition;
(c) whether the Union Cabinet has
given its approval to the proposal; and
(d) if so, by when a final decision in
this regard is likely to be taken?
E-auction leading to fall in coal prices
†2880. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the price of
coal is continuously decreasing after the
implementation of e-auction system for sale
of coal;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government intend to put
in place any alternative system for sale of
coal, if so, the details thereof?
Fly ash from thermal power plants
†2881. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether fly ash emitting from
thermal power plants is being used in coal
mines in Orissa;

666
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether this experiment has been
successful;
(c) if so, whether Government would
consider using the fly ash emitting from
thermal power plants in other coal mines
also; and
(d) if so, by when a decision would be
taken in this regard?
Coal production and gap between
demand and supply
2882. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) the total production of coal in the
country both by Coal India Ltd. and other
captive mines;
(b) the present demands of coal in the
country; and
(c) the details of Government
programme to fill up the gap between
demand and supply?
Import of coal
†2883. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that coal import
in the country is expected to be doubled
from the year 2001-02 to 2006-07;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) whether the domestic production of
coal has also increased during the said
periods; and
(d) if so, the percentage of this increase?
AIIMS like hospital at Kolkata by CIL
2884. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
DR. BARUN MUKHERJEE:
SHRI MOINUL HASSAN:
SHRI SAMAN PATHAK:
SHRI P.R. RAJAN:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the year
2004, Coal India Limited decided to set up
an AIIMS type hospital at Kolkata;
(b) the amount of money has been spent
so far for this project (Head of Account
wise); and
(c) the present status of this project?
Bilateral agreements in coal sectors
2885. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India is on the threshold of
announcing several key bilateral agreements
in the coal sector aimed to set off strategic
public-private partnerships with global
firms;
(b) if so, the details thereof and their
present status;
(c) whether India is pitching for a strong
position in clean coal technologies to
enhance its use as a dominant energy
source, and the multilateral dialogues to
develop the coal sector are progressing at a
fast pace with action-plans for cooperation
on13-14 projects likely to be finalized
shortly; and

667
(d) if so, the details thereof and their
present status?
Coal blocks allotted to private
companies
2886. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the number of new coal blocks have
been allotted to private sector companies
during the last two years for mining; and
(b) the names of the corporate sectors
to whom the land has been allotted in acres,
period of lease and conditions of allotment
such as social sector obligations for the area,
jobs for the locals, compensation for the
displaced etc.?
